note: Lexical provenance schema (v5.17.2, audit F-02/F-03 follow-up). No bundled entry may present an authored gloss, synonym, antonym, or root-etymology claim as classically sourced unless it carries an exact citation in this shape. Entries WITHOUT a citation are valid and MUST be rendered with the explicit unknown/no-attested state — never back-filled.

properties.sourceId: Stable id of the lexical source edition (e.g. 'lisan-al-arab-bulaq').
properties.author: Author/editor as credited in that edition.
properties.edition: Edition string (publisher, place, year or e-version).
properties.location: Volume/page or root-entry locator inside the edition.
properties.url: Optional public locator (must not be an analytics/tracking URL).

appliesTo.quran-dict.json: Optional per-lemma `src` object for authored AR gloss / synonym / antonym lists.
appliesTo.quran-roots-meaning.json: Optional per-root `src` object replacing the generic bundled label per grouped source edition.

rules: Every public semantic claim is either cited with the shape above or explicitly labelled unknown/no-attested.
Antonym lists MUST NOT be fabricated to raise coverage: 271/4763 attested is honest.
Root entries sharing one source edition MUST name that edition per entry (no silent grouping).
